name: Nyx
description: Nyx is the night-sky realm of Theros, the proverbial land of dreams and home of the gods.

description_citations.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Born of the Gods
description_citations.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Born of the Gods". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

summary.text: Nyx is the night-sky realm of Theros, the proverbial land of dreams and home of the gods.

citations.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Born of the Gods
citations.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Born of the Gods". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

bio.text: Kruphix decreed the Silence of the Gods, withdrawing the pantheon into Nyx, and revealed that the gods arose from mortal belief.

citations.text: "Silence of the Gods", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Kruphix", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Xenagos fed on a frenzied revel to breach Nyx and was crowned God of Revels, blurring the line between Nyx and the mortal world.

citations.text: "Great Revel", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Born of the Gods", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Elspeth and Ajani entered Nyx, freed the imprisoned Nylea, and Elspeth killed Xenagos there with Godsend.

citations.text: "Deicide in Nyx", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Nykthos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Heliod then took Godsend and murdered Elspeth.

citations.text: "Heliod", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Kruphix's Insight" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jun 2014.

status.text: It remains the starry realm of the gods of Theros, where the story last shows the gods residing.

citations.text: "Theros", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citations.work: Theros Beyond Death: card flavor text
citations.text: Theros Beyond Death: card flavor text (Theros Beyond Death, 2020), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Heliod's desire for praise brings him into savage conflict with Purphoros; Purphoros' blade falls and is taken by Elspeth.
timeline.quote: fell from the heavens and was taken by a frightened Elspeth

citation.text: "Heliod", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Elspeth's battle with Xenagos in Nyx, Heliod takes Godsend and stabs her, murdering her while taunting her.
timeline.quote: taking Godsend away from her and stabbing her with it

citation.text: "Heliod", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Heliod gives Elspeth's corpse to Ajani Goldmane and departs.
timeline.quote: He gave her corpse to Ajani Goldmane

citation.text: "Heliod", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth and Ajani free Nylea in Nyx, and Elspeth slays Xenagos with an arrow Nylea struck.
timeline.quote: The pair freed her from her magical prison, restoring her true form

citation.text: "Nylea", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nylea forgives Elspeth, but Heliod kills Elspeth with Godsend.
timeline.quote: Heliod killed Elspeth with her weapon, Godsend

citation.text: "Nylea", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Raissa revisits the starfish and sees the constellations of Nyx turn on her son in outrage and advance with storms.
timeline.quote: They faced Raissa's son, and outrage flared in their eyes.

citation.text: "Raissa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth throws her spear into Xenagos' chest, exploding the arrowhead Nylea shot into him and killing him.
timeline.quote: Elspeth managed to throw the spear into Xenagos's chest

citation.text: "Theros (plane)", section "The rise and fall of Xenagos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kruphix enacted the Silence of the Gods, keeping the gods in Nyx.
timeline.quote: Kruphix then enacted the Silence of the Gods

citation.text: "Xenagos", section "Return to Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth and Ajani arrived in Nyx, and Xenagos knocked Elspeth down.
timeline.quote: Elspeth and her friend Ajani arrived in Nyx to set Theros right again.

citation.text: "Xenagos", section "Deicide in Nyx". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth threw Godsend into Xenagos's chest, detonating Nylea's arrowhead and killing him in Nyx.
timeline.quote: Elspeth managed to throw the spear into Xenagos's chest

citation.text: "Xenagos", section "Deicide in Nyx". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xenagos returns to Theros and performs rituals to become god of revels, blurring the line between Nyx and the mortal world.
timeline.quote: These rituals had an unanticipated side effect: the blurring of the lines between the realm of the gods and everyday existence.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Born of the Gods
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Born of the Gods". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The gods realize a mortal has forced his way into the pantheon and fear their nature as creations of the world being revealed.
timeline.quote: a mortal has launched himself into Nyx and forced his way into the pantheon

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Born of the Gods
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Born of the Gods". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Xenagos returns to Theros to become the god of revels as the boundary with Nyx thins and Nyxborn pour into the mortal world.
timeline.quote: the planeswalker Xenagos returns to Theros to become the god of revels.

citation.text: "Born of the Gods", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The victory celebration becomes the ritual that launches Xenagos into Nyx as a god; Elspeth is blamed and driven away.
timeline.quote: Elspeth is blamed for his ascension and driven away in disgrace.

citation.text: "Born of the Gods", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At night Leandros asks Mnesos why the gods have abandoned them and whether they will return; Mnesos says the gods have retreated into Nyx before.
timeline.quote: The historians tell us that this is not the first time the gods have retreated into Nyx

citation.text: "The Walls of Akros" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Feb 2014.

timeline.summary: Cilissa enters the clearing and sees the portal to Nyx open in the sky above.
timeline.quote: Nyx. The home of the gods.

citation.text: "Seasons in Setessa". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Elspeth and Ajani prepare to face Xenagos in Nyx, Elspeth armed with Godsend.
timeline.quote: Now Elspeth and Ajani face Xenagos on his home ground.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Journey into Nyx
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Journey into Nyx". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Xenagos casts a vine dome over the valley to block the gods' sight, wary of Nylea.
timeline.quote: a thicket of ethereal vines crawled over the valley and settled like a living dome above them all

citation.work: Theros eBook Godsend , Part 1: Sample Chapter
citation.text: "Theros eBook Godsend , Part 1: Sample Chapter". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: War breaks out between the enchantment creatures and mortals in Journey into Nyx.
timeline.quote: war would break out between the enchantment creatures and the mortals in Journey into Nyx

citation.text: "My Journey". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Xenocrates argues that gods are the patterns mortals recognize, personified through the power of Nyx, and that mortals are responsible for their gods; Melantha forbids it as blasphemy.
timeline.quote: Through the power of Nyx, we are responsible for our gods.

citation.text: "Dreams of the City" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2014.

timeline.summary: In the vision the constellations of Nyx turn on Raissa's son with outrage and lightning, and he rises to meet them on a cloud of red and green power with a gleaming staff.
timeline.quote: outrage flared in their eyes

citation.text: "Thank the Gods" by Clayton Kroh. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2014.

timeline.summary: Elspeth fears her trespass into Nyx will not go unanswered.
timeline.quote: Elspeth feared that her trespass into Nyx would not go unanswered.

citation.text: Worst Fears (Journey into Nyx, 2014), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Supported by Ajani, Elspeth travels to Nyx and kills Xenagos.
timeline.quote: Supported by Ajani , Elspeth travels to Nyx and kills Xenagos .

citation.text: "Journey into Nyx", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Flashback: from Kruphix's Temple, Kydele watches Xenagos become a god and Elspeth, with Ajani, use Godsend to cut him from the sky.
timeline.quote: She saw Elspeth use the blade called Godsend to cut Xenagos from the sky.

citation.text: "Kruphix's Insight" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Heliod snatches Godsend from Elspeth and murders her with it, claiming a champion cannot know more than her god.
timeline.quote: And then he murdered her, his own champion, with her own weapon.

citation.text: "Kruphix's Insight" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: Before Xenagos's rise, Kruphix declared the Silence of the Gods to restore balance after chaos in Nyx.
timeline.quote: Kruphix declared the Silence of the Gods

citation.text: "Kruphix", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kruphix revealed that the gods arose from mortal belief, and even he does not predate it.
timeline.quote: Kruphix revealed that the gods of Theros arose from mortal belief, shaping the fabric of Nyx.

citation.text: "Kruphix", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Cymede is claimed by Keranos and ascends into Nyx as a pillar of fire and crimson light.
timeline.quote: Cymede was claimed by Keranos as she transformed into a pillar of fire and crimson light

citation.text: "Cymede", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Erebos tests Elspeth with an illusion of a family life; she smashes the golden cup and enters Nyx.
timeline.quote: By smashing the illusion’s golden cup, she proved her resolve and gained entry to the starry realm of the gods.

citation.text: "Deicide in Nyx", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: They free the imprisoned Nylea and fight Xenagos; Elspeth thrusts Godsend into his chest, ending his godhood.
timeline.quote: Elspeth thrust Godsend into the satyr-god's chest, exploding the arrowhead and rending his heart apart

citation.text: "Deicide in Nyx", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth asks Erebos to trade her soul for Daxos's, and he agrees.
timeline.quote: Erebos agreed, pleased to claim the soul of a mortal who dared slay a god.

citation.text: "Deicide in Nyx", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xenagos feeds on the frenzied revel to breach Nyx and is crowned the new God of Revels.
timeline.quote: The mortals’ wild belief crowned him the new God of Revels amid chaos, carnage, and ecstatic dance.

citation.text: "Great Revel", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth and Ajani, aided by Nylea, confront Xenagos at the Nyx Nykthos; Elspeth slays him with Godsend.
timeline.quote: Elspeth slew Xenagos with the god-forged blade Godsend

citation.text: "Nykthos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kruphix decrees the Silence of the Gods, withdrawing the pantheon into Nyx; Xenagos ascends to godhood as God of Revels.
timeline.quote: He decreed the Silence of the Gods

citation.text: "Silence of the Gods", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.note: The vision shows the constellation gods arrayed in outrage against her son.
relations.quote: They faced Raissa—no, they were facing her son!

citation.text: "Thank the Gods" by Clayton Kroh. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2014.
